rows.text: returns 0 when `rdx` or `rcx` is null; otherwise walks the circular list headed at `rcx + 0x90` (a link equal to the head ends it), skips nodes whose qword `+0x18` is null, byte-compares each node's `+0x18` string with the string at `rdx` up to the terminator and returns the first node that matches; when a list is exhausted it moves to the object at qword `+0x78` and repeats, returning 0 once that qword is null
computes the signed offset dword `+0x48` of `rcx` minus dword `+0xF4` of the object at qword `+0x18` of `rcx`, and returns the qword at `rdx` + that offset + 8
computes the signed offset dword `+0x48` of `rcx` minus dword `+0xF4` of the object at qword `+0x18` of `rcx`, and returns the dword at `rdx` + that offset with bit 31 cleared (`btr 0x1f`)

addresses the record at `rdx` + (dword `+0x48` of `rcx` minus dword `+0xF4` of the object at qword `+0x18` of `rcx`, signed) and returns 5 when `r9d` is negative (signed); otherwise calls `00584730` on the record's qword `+8` when it differs from `r8`, is non-null and bit 31 of the record's dword `+0` is clear, then stores `r8` at qword `+8`, stores `r9d` with bit 31 set (`bts 0x1f`) at dword `+0` and returns 0
when `rdx` is non-null, calls `006373D0` (with `rcx` unchanged) and then `00632E80(rdx, that result, 0, the address 02CF8270)`; on both paths returns with `al` = 1

addresses the record at `rdx` + (dword `+0x48` of `rcx` minus dword `+0xF4` of the object at qword `+0x18` of `rcx`, signed) and reads its dword `+0` with bit 31 cleared: above 1 (unsigned) it returns the record's qword `+8`, at 1 it returns the address record + 8, and at 0 it returns 0

returns 5 when `r8d` is negative (signed); otherwise takes the old storage of `rcx` (qword `+8` when dword `+0` with bit 31 cleared is above 1 unsigned, the address `rcx + 8` when it is 1, null when 0); when `r8d` is 1 it copies the `0x48` bytes at `rdx` field by field to `rcx + 8` except that `+0x28` receives the address `00D68DD0` (copy skipped if `rcx + 8` is null), making `rcx + 8` the new storage and 1 the new count, else the new storage is `rdx` and the new count `r8d` with bit 31 set; calls `00584730` on the old storage when it differs from the new storage and from `rcx + 8`, is non-null and bit 31 of dword `+0` is clear; stores the new storage at qword `+8` unless it is `rcx + 8`, stores the new count at dword `+0` and returns 0
stores `rdx` at qword `+0` of `rcx`, zeroes qword `+8` and returns `rcx`

returns 0 at once when `edx` equals the whole dword `+0` of `rcx`; otherwise takes the old storage (qword `+8` when dword `+0` with bit 31 cleared is above 1 unsigned, the address `rcx + 8` when it is 1, null when 0) and calls `006C7450(rcx, edx, old storage, the unsigned minimum of edx and that count)`; when the result is null and `edx` is non-zero it returns 0xD, else it calls `00584730` on the old storage when that differs from the result and from `rcx + 8`, is non-null and bit 31 of dword `+0` is clear, stores the result at qword `+8` unless it is `rcx + 8`, stores `edx` at dword `+0` and returns 0
